body:
I am 30 with lots of experience in just about everything. I found a bottle of liquid valium, 10 mL of 5mg/mL. I was drunk one night and thought it would be fun to mix in some valium. I drew up 1 mL and went for a vein, though I had never found a vein before while injecting myself. I got unlucky enough to hit a vein this time so I went for it. As soon as I did my heart started racing and I had to vomit fairly quickly. It was like it caused a reverse reaction and it lasted all night. I would never inject this ever again. It also burns really bad, worse than pepcid, if you have ever had it injected. I wouldn't even inject it SC or IM, it's just not worth the possibility of going into a vein.
